rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The resolution 'BJP's Election Victory-Government Formation and the Tasks Ahead', printed under 'National Executive / New Delhi 11-12 April, 1998', says under 'Gratitude for Advaniji's true leadership': 'The National Executive expresses its profound gratitude to the party President, Shri LK Advani, for leading the BJP to victory'.
